pr_title: Display current version in common format in AVM Fritz!Tools
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The current version is returned like `<HW-Version>.<major>.<minor>` (_eq. `154.07.39`_) but only shown as `<major>.<minor>`  (_eq. `7.39`_) in all places of the device WebUI. Further in case a new version is available, it is only provided in format `<major>.<minor>` (_eq. `7.50`_). This leads to a failing update entity, because `154.07.39` will always be considered to be the higher version compared to `7.50` by the update entity.

This PR will remove the `<HW-Version>` and a trailing zero from `<major>`, to make the current and new available versions comparable.

issue_context.title: Fritz!Box update entity doesn't show updates due to mismatched version formats
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The fritz integration adds an `update` entity which should inform about new updates, but it detects the current and available versions in different formats which leads to the entity always reporting being "up to date" (`off`).

The current version is detected as `154.07.50`, while the version displayed in the fritz!box webinterface is just `7.50`.

The latest available version is detected as `7.56`

Interesting behaviour as the latest version is shown only if the `update_available` is True.
So your screenshot seems a sort of mix :-S

Once my Fritz is back home, I'll investigate.

Simone

Can confirm the issue. HA displays no update available (for me 154.07.55 to 7.55).

Yes the fritztools confirm update available returning available version.

I think the problem relies on the update entity itself. As far as I understand the update entity calculates by itself if an update is available by comparing the provided versions. But 154.07.55 is larger than 7.56 therefore home assistant thinks that the installed version is newer than the available. 

Since the versions displayed in the fritz ui is also only two digit probably best would be to strip the version to last two blocks. Or can be the comparison overwritten by the component? Can take a look into it tomorrow.

@chemelli74 I got it running in my dev container by transorming the version with a helper that truncates the version to the two last parts (removing leading zeros): [dev..feature/fix-fritz-version-handling](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/compare/dev...Mask3007:ha-core:feature/fix-fritz-version-handling) But python is not my daily driver. The fix feels not right for me, therefore created no pr. Maybe you could take a sneak into it and use some of it when you got into it. But at least this fixes the issue. Proof:

I noticed that in the [XML file that contains the FRITZ!Box' system version info](http://fritz.box:49000/tr64desc.xml), the three parts are listed as major (`154`), minor (`7`) and patch (`50`) version, see the first block of log-data in the original issue for the original format. 

I did some more digging, and in the debug data you can get from http://fritz.box/#support (log in, then change the URL-hash manually to prevent the automatic redirect to the index page after logging in), the versions are actually listed as:

```
CONFIG_VERSION=07.50
CONFIG_VERSION_MAJOR=154
(...)
```

So `154.07.50` looks like a SemVer number, but it actually isn't one. Some more digging brought me [here](https://boxmatrix.info/wiki/Property:CONFIG_VERSION_MAJOR) and [here](https://boxmatrix.info/wiki/Property:CONFIG_VERSION), and it seems as if the major version is used as a model-ID, not for actual versioning - further supported by the fact that it doesn't show up anywhere in the UI. Additionally, AVM's so called "patch" version of `x.y.50` is actually a "minor.patch" of `y.5.0`, while `56` would be `y.5.6` - see [here, (unfortunately in German)](https://www.ip-phone-forum.de/threads/fritz-box-3490-release-7-29-vom-10-08-2021.310965/#post-2440731). So the AVM-version `154.07.50` actually translates to SemVer as:
- (Model-ID `154`)
- Major `7`
- Minor `5`
- Patch `0`

I'm not sure if the adjusted parsing is something that should happen in the HA integration, or maybe directly in fritzconnection -  shouldn't the library already report the "correct" current version (eg `7.50`) in other places (docs [a](https://fritzconnection.readthedocs.io/en/1.12.0/sources/fritzconnection_api.html?highlight=version#fritzconnection.core.devices.DeviceManager.system_version), [b](https://fritzconnection.readthedocs.io/en/1.12.0/sources/fritzconnection_api.html?highlight=version#fritzconnection.core.processor.SystemVersion.version))?
